title: RRB Group D 28 Nov 2025 Shift 1 - General Awareness and Current Affairs - Government Reports and Indices
subject: General Awareness and Current Affairs

questions.q: As per the Sustainable Development Goals – National Indicator Framework Progress Report, 2025, published in June 2025, India’s installed renewable energy capacity rose from 64.04 watts per capita in 2014–15 to 156.31 watts per capita in 2024–25. This growth primarily supports which Sustainable Development Goal (SDG)?
questions.explain: Sustainable Development Goal 7 (SDG 7) aims to ensure access to affordable, reliable, sustainable and modern energy for all, which aligns directly with the growth in installed renewable energy capacity.
